comparison.objective: Perform a temporal-scanner sweep across a manikin forehead and behind its ear, then cradle the scanner.
comparison.physical_skill: Maintain flush, square, slow tool contact along a curved path while holding a button.
comparison.success_condition: Required path bins, hairline endpoint, and behind-ear dwell occur in one press; scanner finishes released in its cradle.
comparison.reason: This is contact-path following on a curved surface, not coupled threaded adjustment or retention under locknut torque.
